decisions.decision: Build everything now. (1) In this repo, rename every 'Chaperone' to 'Tantra Enterprise' in funnel-os-challenge.tsx and funnel-os-types/system.tsx. Leave real-foundation.ts as it is. Rebuild workshop-plan/build/funnels.py, run probe-funnel-boards.mjs, republish the mirror and check that the challenge board says Tantra Enterprise. (2) Clone Usetantra/tantra-frontend-v2 on branch adi-new-ui. Replace calendly-embed.tsx with a Cal.com inline embed (embed.js, Cal('inline')). Rename the constant to ENTERPRISE_CALCOM_URL = https://cal.com/adisuja/tantra-enterprise-evaluation-call. Keep the 'Request a call' fallback card for when that URL does not answer 200. Remove the live Calendly description fetch. Put the owner's description in the repo as a constant, with the corrections (1 year, no $50M, no testimonials, no SMS). Drop applyOwnerCorrections. Run npm test and the voice probe. Push. Write a draft of the event fields for Adi's review.
